module_summary: 64-bit AXI-Stream Ethernet FCS checker: a 3-state FSM passes frames through a one-word delay, updates a CRC32 via parallel LFSR instances, checks the residue by tkeep width and flags bad frames through tuser, ending in a skid-buffered output register.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST frame FSM controlling ready, CRC reset/update and output tlast/tuser

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 accumulator updated from 64-bit LFSR each accepted beat

anchors.name: crc_state3
anchors.why: CRC after lower 32 bits, used for final-cycle residue check of upper half

anchors.name: crc_next7
anchors.why: Full 64-bit LFSR next-CRC result loaded into crc_state

anchors.name: crc_valid3
anchors.why: CRC residue match flag (representative of per-width checks) deciding bad FCS

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: FSM-generated enable loading new CRC values on accepted beat

anchors.name: shift_in
anchors.why: Load enable for one-word input delay registers

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_d0
anchors.why: One-beat delayed input data forwarded to output while CRC is checked

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep_d0
anchors.why: Delayed tkeep selecting CRC width check in LAST state

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid_d0
anchors.why: Delayed valid indicating delay register holds a beat

anchors.name: last_cycle_tkeep_reg
anchors.why: Holds upper-half tkeep for the extra LAST output cycle

anchors.name: last_cycle_tuser_reg
anchors.why: Holds input tuser for the extra LAST output cycle

anchors.name: last_cycle
anchors.why: Selects delayed upper data and crc_state3 into LFSR inputs during LAST

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse output indicating frame with bad FCS

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy indication when FSM not idle

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; with ready triggers shift, CRC update and FSM advance

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from FSM and output buffer space

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame data feeding LFSRs and delay register

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables choosing final-beat CRC width and output tkeep

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker driving FSM to check CRC

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output frame data from output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output tuser marking frames with bad FCS or input error

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating output transfer and LAST state exit

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer data held when output stalled

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag affecting early ready

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Enable loading internal datapath into output registers

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output data chosen by FSM before output register

groups.name: Frame FSM
groups.description: Controls frame acceptance, CRC reset/update, last-cycle handling and error reporting

groups.name: CRC engine
groups.description: Parallel LFSR CRC32 instances with residue checks for each final-beat width

groups.name: Input delay stage
groups.description: One-beat delay of input data/keep/valid and last-cycle side registers

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output register plus temp register implementing AXI-Stream skid buffer
